sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: You call this letter (M) /em/. Its main sound is the sound /m/, as heard in (milk) /mɪlk/. This word means milk. The letter has two sounds across English words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close your lips completely and let air flow smoothly through your nose. Turn on your voice so your throat vibrates. You can place two fingers gently on your neck to feel the vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In most positions, you pronounce the sound /m/, like in the word (map) /mæp/. When placed before the letter n at the start of a word, this letter is not pronounced, like in (mnemonic) /nə.mɒn.ɪk/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Learners sometimes open their lips too soon at the end of a word. Keep your lips closed firmly until the humming sound stops completely. This letter causes very few problems.
